senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. עוּר I)to stir up.
to stimulate, esp. to excite the sexual organ by contact (as the first stage of sexual connection), v. הַעֲרָאָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 2:4">Ker. II, 4</cite> <he>כל העריות עשה בהן את המַעֲרֶה כגומר</he> in all illicit connections the text makes him who passes through the first stage as punishable as him that finishes. Y. Keth. III, 27ᵈ <he>הֶעֱרוּ בה עשרה וכ׳</he> if ten persons came in carnal contact with her, and one of them consummated.

<cite ref="Sotah 42b:6">Sot. 42ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>מע̇ר̇ות</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 17:23">I Sam. XVII, 23</cite>) <he>שהכל הע̇ר̇ו באמו</he> all the world had taken liberties with his mother; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to intermix. Y. Yoma V, 42ᵈ top (צריך) זקוק להַעְרוֹת he must mix (the blood of the bull with that of the goat), v. Pi
to be interwoven, entangled, caught. Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ bot. בסירה הוּעֲרַת it (the skirt) was caught &c., v. עָדָה I; ib. הוּעֲרוּ; Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ (also הָעֳרַת).

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:4">Yoma V, 4</cite> <he>עי׳ דם הפר לתוך וכ׳</he> he poured the blood of the bullock to that of the goat, and put the full bowl in the empty one; expl.

ib. 58ᵃ עי׳ מזרק מלא וכ׳ he poured the contents of the filled bowl into the empty bowl … in order to mix them thoroughly. Y. ib. V, 42ᵈ top (interch. with בָּלַל a. עָרַב). Y. Maasr. I, end, 49ᵇ לעָרוֹת וכ׳ to pour into &c. (interch. with להַעֲרוֹת, Hif.); Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵇ.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 10:6">Nidd. X, 6</cite> <he>היתה מְעָרָה מים לפסח</he> was permitted to pour water from vessel to vessel for Passover purposes (to wash the Passover meat without touching the water).

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:7">Ab. Zar. V, 7</cite> <he>המְעָרֶה מכלי אל כלי</he> if a Jew pours wine from one vessel into another (held by a gentile), <he>את שעי׳ ממנו מותר</he> the wine remaining in the vessel from which he poured is permitted; a. fr.—Sifra K’dosh., Par. 2, ch. V <he>עי׳ כל הפרשה כולה לכי וכ׳</he> the writer intended to join the whole paragraph (concerning emancipation) to ‘for she has not been set free’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 19:20">Lev. XIX, 20</cite>), to intimate that emancipation is consummated by a document only; (<cite ref="Gittin 39b:12">Gitt. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>אוֹרְעָה וכ׳</he> (fr. <cite ref="A03216"><he>אָרַע</he> I</cite>) the whole paragraph has been joined &c.

B. Bath. 113ᵇ אורעה … להיות דין, v. אָרַע II, a. corr. acc.) Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵈ bot. (ref. to Deut. XXV, 5) ת״ל ויבמה עי׳ הפרשה כולה לייבום וכ׳ the text says, v’yibb’mah (‘and thus he shall be her levir’); the whole paragraph is connected with yibbum (the word ויבמה), intimating that marital connection only consummates the levirate marriage; Y. Yeb. II, beg. 3ᶜ עודה (Rabad to Sifra l. c. quotes עורה, corr. acc.). Y. Snh. VII, 24ᵈ עֵרָה את כל וכ׳ the whole paragraph depends on the word mother.—Part. pass. מְעוּרֶה; f. מְעוּרָה; pl. מְעוּרִים, מְעוּרִין; מְעוּרוֹת intertwined, interwoven; mixed up.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 3:1">T’bul Yom III, 1</cite> <he>אוכל שנפרס ומע׳ מקצת</he> if an eatable part of a fruit is broken off but partly hangs on (is not entirely severed).

<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:8">Ukts. III, 8</cite> <he>יחור של … ומע׳ בקליפה</he> a shoot of a fig tree which is torn off but is still attached to the tree by the rind; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 1:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. I, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 54a:11">Yoma 54ᵃ</cite> <he>הכרובים שהיו מע׳ זה בזה</he> the cherubs (in the Temple) whose bodies were intertwisted with one another.
<cite ref="Yoma 54a:11">Ib.</cite> sq. (expl. <he>כמער איש וליות</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 7:36">I Kings VII, 36</cite>) <he>כאיש המע׳ בלויה שלו</he> like a man embracing his companion (wife).
<cite ref="Chullin 127b:6">Ḥull. 127ᵇ</cite> <he>ומע׳ בחוט השערה</he> attached by a hair’s breadth.

senses.gloss: to be intertwined, come into intimate contact.
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:20">Ruth R. to I, 14</cite> (ref. to <he>מערית</he>, v. supra) <he>ממאה … שנִתְעָרוּ בה וכ׳</he> on one hundred … that were in contact with her the whole night (interch. with <he>נתערבו</he>).
